name: Middlebury Stereo 2014 Benchmark
description: The Middlebury Stereo 2014 dataset is an established stereo vision benchmark featuring high-resolution indoor scenes captured using structured light illumination. Comprising 33 scenes (15 training scenes, 15 test scenes, and 3 additional scenes) with dense subpixel-accurate disparity maps under various exposures and lighting conditions.
